items.title: Finiteness and finite presentation of the constant sheaf attached to a module over a site
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma characterizes finite type and finite presentability of the constant sheaf associated to a module in terms of the module itself, assuming the topos is not empty. The proof of the finite type statement is two-sided: global sections of the constant sheaf coming from generators of the module generate it, and conversely a finite local generating family may be refined so that its sections come from elements of the module, which then generate; the second half additionally shows that elements whose global sections generate must generate the module, by refining a covering and using that a non-sheaf-theoretically-empty object has at least one covering member contributing (proof lines 8576-8620). H2: the two covering refinements and the reduction to a single nonempty object are the substance, and both are written out.
